observed_failure.symptom: MIM_OPERATOR_STATUS.latest.json kept current_objective_id=MIM-LAB-AWARENESS-HUMAN-INTERACTION-V1 but stale classification/request_type/what_mim_is_doing fields claimed TOD implementation replan.
observed_failure.cause: The lab-awareness gateway route wrote correct lab artifacts, but the TOD packet listener later reconciled a stale TOD request and rewrote operator status using implementation wording.
observed_failure.risk: Operator and monitor surfaces can appear to be on the right objective while still reporting the wrong owner and next action.

correction_applied.gateway_route: Lab-awareness route now writes a complete MIM_OPERATOR_STATUS.latest.json for request_type=mim_lab_runtime.
correction_applied.tod_packet_listener: Listener now classifies MIM-LAB-AWARENESS objectives as mim_lab_runtime and preserves MIM ownership/status wording instead of TOD implementation wording.

validated_status.next_safe_action: run/connect MIM lab sensor inventory and publish per-device evidence

lesson.title: A corrected route must also protect downstream status reconciliation
lesson.rule: When a runtime objective is corrected away from TOD implementation routing, every later status writer must preserve the corrected owner, request type, blocker, and next action.
resolution_pattern: Verify MIM_OPERATOR_STATUS.latest.json after downstream listeners have had time to run.
If the operator status regresses, patch the downstream status reconciler rather than treating the lab objective as complete.

required_next_mim_action: Continue the lab-awareness objective by running or binding the MIM-owned lab sensor inventory runner.
tod_codex_boundary: monitor and guide only; do not implement camera, microphone, TTS, human memory, or object recognition work for MIM
